items.description: Verify schedule_tasks function exists with correct signature accepting tasks list and dependencies list
items.expected_behavior: Function is callable with parameters (tasks: list[str], dependencies: list[tuple[str, str]]) and returns list[str]

items.description: Verify function returns all tasks exactly once in output
items.expected_behavior: Output list contains each input task exactly once with no duplicates or omissions

items.description: Verify dependency ordering is respected for simple linear chain
items.expected_behavior: For dependencies (A, B), task A appears before task B in output; example: fetch_data before clean_data before train_model before evaluate_model

items.description: Verify lexicographic ordering when multiple tasks are available
items.expected_behavior: When no dependencies constrain task order, tasks are returned in lexicographically sorted order

items.description: Verify empty input returns empty output
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks([], []) returns []

items.description: Verify single task with no dependencies returns that task
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks(['task1'], []) returns ['task1']

items.description: Verify multiple independent tasks are returned in lexicographic order
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks(['b', 'a', 'c'], []) returns ['a', 'b', 'c']

items.description: Verify diamond-shaped dependency graph is handled correctly
items.expected_behavior: For diamond graph with a->b, a->c, b->d, c->d, returns valid order where a is first, d is last, and b,c are between them

items.description: Verify multiple independent dependency chains are ordered deterministically
items.expected_behavior: When multiple chains exist with no cross-dependencies, output respects all dependencies and uses lexicographic ordering for available tasks

items.description: Verify long dependency chain maintains correct order
items.expected_behavior: For a chain of n tasks with sequential dependencies, output preserves the chain order

items.description: Verify ValueError raised for duplicate task names
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks(['a', 'b', 'a'], []) raises ValueError with message indicating duplicate tasks

items.description: Verify ValueError raised when dependency references unknown task
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks(['a', 'b'], [('a', 'c')]) raises ValueError indicating task 'c' is not in task list

items.description: Verify ValueError raised for circular dependency
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks(['a', 'b'], [('a', 'b'), ('b', 'a')]) raises ValueError indicating circular dependency

items.description: Verify ValueError raised for self-referential dependency
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks(['a'], [('a', 'a')]) raises ValueError indicating circular dependency

items.description: Verify TypeError raised when tasks parameter is not a list
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks('not_a_list', []) raises TypeError

items.description: Verify TypeError raised when dependencies parameter is not a list
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks(['a'], 'not_a_list') raises TypeError

items.description: Verify TypeError raised when task name is not a string
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks(['a', 123], []) raises TypeError

items.description: Verify TypeError raised when dependency is not a pair of strings
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks(['a', 'b'], [('a', 'b', 'c')]) raises TypeError for non-pair tuple

items.description: Verify TypeError raised when dependency pair contains non-string elements
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks(['a', 'b'], [(1, 'b')]) raises TypeError

items.description: Verify task names are case-sensitive
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks(['A', 'a'], []) treats 'A' and 'a' as distinct tasks and returns them in lexicographic order

items.description: Verify function does not execute tasks or modify external state
items.expected_behavior: Function returns ordering only without side effects; can be called multiple times with same result

items.description: Verify deterministic output on repeated calls with same input
items.expected_behavior: Multiple calls to schedule_tasks with identical inputs return identical outputs

items.description: Verify empty dependencies list with multiple tasks returns lexicographic order
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks(['z', 'a', 'm'], []) returns ['a', 'm', 'z']

items.description: Verify complex graph with multiple dependencies per task
items.expected_behavior: Task with multiple predecessors appears after all of them; task with multiple successors appears before all of them

items.description: Verify ValueError for dependency referencing unknown task in 'before' position
items.expected_behavior: schedule_tasks(['a', 'b'], [('unknown', 'a')]) raises ValueError

summary: Comprehensive test plan for the Task Scheduler module covering API shape, normal behavior, edge cases, error handling, and boundary conditions.
